title: QOL Commands
description: This mod adds a mod that adds commands that are small but nice to have.
body:
**This mod adds a bunch of QOL (Quality of life) commands that are small but nice to have.**

### Here are all of the commands that are currently in the mod:


- ```/heal <entity>``` Heals the chosen entity.

- ```/feed <player>``` Feeds the chosen player.

- ```/explode <entity>``` Explodes the selected entity.

- ```/looktp <distance>``` Makes you teleport a chosen amount of blocks towards where you're looking at.

- ```/rtp <range>``` Makes you teleport between the chosen range.

- ```/unstuck``` Teleports the player to the nearest standable block above the player.

- ```/sethome``` Sets the player's home.

- ```/home``` Teleports the player to their home.

- ```/repair``` Repairs the item that you're currently holding.

- ```/dupe``` Duplicates the item that you're currently holding. (Note: It becomes very unstable above 64 items in one slot.)

- ```/spawn``` Teleports you to the world's spawn point.

- ```/fly <players> <enabled>``` Forces the selected player(s) to fly / stop flying, even if the selected player(s) are in survival mode.

- ```/disabledamage <players> <enabled>``` Disables / Enables damage for the seleted player(s).

- ```/despawn <entities>``` Despawns the selected entity(s).

- ```/walkspeed <speed>``` Sets the player's walkspeed. (Default is 1.)

- ```/jumpstrength <strength>``` Sets the player's jump strength. (Default is 1.)

- ```/scale <scale>``` Sets the player's scale. (Default is 1.)

If you have any issues or suggestions, please join our discord server and let us know. If you can't find what you're looking for, DM me (@mikan_gaming).
